# Formal Limit — Source-Specific Limits and Their Consequences

## #0 — What the account has reached

<a id="limit-and-recurring-gap"></a>
A limit becomes informative when the account identifies the operation that reaches it. A contradiction in a collecting rule, a sentence independent of an axiomatized theory, an attempted statement of logical form, and a predicate applied to God each present a different task. Their consequences become comparable through the work they require: change a permission, examine a proof relation, clarify what an utterance does, or recover the respect under which a name applies. This dossier develops that comparison while leaving each source answerable for its own claim.

[A03, Immutable Gap / Formal Limit](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the native pressure. Including the conditions of an account produces a further account whose present occurrence has conditions. Successful reflection therefore makes something newly explicit while renewing the difference between its content and its act. [C04, Formal Limit](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) **defines** an operation's constraint under specified conditions; [C05, Immutable Gap](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C05-Immutable-Gap.md) **defines** that recurrent non-coincidence. A formal revision can remove a particular obstruction. The act of revision still participates in the field it seeks to articulate.

The distinction gives inquiry two positive duties. It must identify what the present method can determine and carry that determination as far as its warrant allows. It must also disclose what its own operation presupposes. An unperformed measurement calls for measurement. A contradiction calls for an examination of the premises and rules that produced it. Neither becomes evidence for an unknown being merely by being called a limit. The native Subject relation is developed in [the complete theorem field](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md), which **grounds** its own eightfold movement; the external witnesses below qualify its comparisons.

## #1 — A contradiction changes what may be formed

<a id="russell-formation-and-repair"></a>
Russell's paradox begins with a permission: an untyped set is allowed for every expressible membership condition. Apply that unrestricted comprehension to objects that are not members of themselves, and name the resulting set `R`. The rule permits substitution of `R` into its own defining condition, giving `R ∈ R ↔ R ∉ R`. Each side entails its negation. The failure belongs to the joint formation and substitution permissions; there is no undecided membership value waiting for more observations.

[Russell's 1908 theory-of-types house](../sources/mathematics-logic/russell/russell-1908-theory-types/russell-1908-theory-types.md#russell-1908-theory-types-q001) **sources** the vicious-circle restriction at §IV, p.237. The [developed Russell Matheme](../../matheme/formal-neighbours/russell-types.md) **derives** the contradiction and distinguishes two repairs. Its simple type illustration permits an object of level `n` to belong to a collection of level `n+1`; self-membership is inadmissible before any truth value is assigned. Separation instead allows collection only from an already given set `S`. The resulting `R_S` cannot belong to `S`, so the original substitution no longer produces the same contradiction. One repair changes the admissible expression; the other changes the collecting permission.

The restriction continues to permit construction. A collection can itself enter a collection at an appropriate level, and exclusion can define a complement within a stated domain. The account has become more exact about what “all” ranges over. Russell's ramified theory also distinguishes orders of definition; the simple membership hierarchy displays a barrier without replacing his whole system. [Whitehead and Russell's joint *Principia Mathematica*](../sources/mathematics-logic/whitehead/whitehead-russell-1910-1913-principia/whitehead-russell-1910-1913-principia.md) **historicises** the continuing logical project. Its particular derivations require volume and proposition locators, independently of the already developed contradiction.

This changes the return to A03. An account can expose a rule, explain why it fails, and adopt a defensible restriction. That is a real achievement of reflection. The native distinction concerns the activity through which this revision is made, while the Russell result concerns which formations the revised system allows. [C64, Paradox as Cross-Register Hinge](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) **compares** the transition by retaining the exact obstruction and the valid work that survives its repair. Treating every cut as loss would erase the constructive force of the type rule itself.

## #2 — An admissible sentence exceeds a fixed proof relation

<a id="godel-relative-unprovability"></a>
[Gödel's 1931 article](../sources/mathematics-logic/godel/godel-1931-undecidable-propositions/godel-1931-undecidable-propositions.md) **sources** incompleteness within formal arithmetic. Here the sentence is well formed. The limit concerns derivability in a specified theory. The house's ready note fragments do not substitute for the theorem statements.

For a consistent, effectively axiomatized theory `F` containing Robinson arithmetic, the Gödel–Rosser result supplies a sentence neither provable nor refutable in `F`. Gödel's original route used the stronger ω-consistency assumption for the unrefutability direction; Rosser's 1936 refinement changes the construction. The ordinary Gödel sentence is already unprovable under consistency. The second theorem concerns the unprovability in `F` of its appropriately formalized consistency statement, with sufficient arithmetic and suitable derivability conditions on its provability predicate. It is not an assertion that `F` can say nothing about itself. Adding an independent sentence as an axiom changes the theory; if the extension remains in the theorem's class, incompleteness applies to that extension too. [Raatikainen's fixed Spring 2026 account, §§1.1, 2.5 and 3.2](https://plato.stanford.edu/archives/spr2026/entries/goedel-incompleteness/) **qualifies** these distinctions; its [canonical source house](../sources/mathematics-logic/raatikainen/raatikainen-2026-godel-incompleteness-sep/raatikainen-2026-godel-incompleteness-sep.md) retains the independent exposition identity.

The source-specific consequence is an exact change in the question asked. “Has this claim been proved?” must retain the theory in which proof is meant. “Can this theory establish its consistency?” must retain the formula and proof predicate being used. A result established from further assumptions has acquired a new warrant; those assumptions belong in the returned account. This gives A03 an exact comparative discipline without turning its determining-act argument into a corollary of arithmetic.

The developmental copula carrier used the unrestricted formula that no closed system proves its own totality. That wording loses both the mathematical object and the hypotheses. Its correction leaves the author's recognitive argument in force: the living traversal of a definition has its own office. It removes a false mathematical guarantee of that office. A source-bound argument can thus gain precision while keeping its positive proposition.

There is also a difference from Russell at the point of continuation. The inconsistent collecting permission could not remain as stated. Incompleteness under the stated hypotheses leaves a consistent theory with genuine theorems and effective proof checking. Extending it is further mathematical work. Faith, phenomenality and the Subject are not values supplied by the unproved sentence. Their native development returns through a different relation below.

## #3 — Saying encounters its own manner of working

<a id="wittgenstein-saying-and-use"></a>
The *Tractatus* locates a difficulty in what representation must share with what it represents. At 4.12–4.1212, logical form is exhibited in propositions; attempting to represent it as another fact would require the standpoint the argument denies. At 6.54 the book turns that demand upon its own elucidations: their work includes being overcome. Proposition 7's silence follows this traversal. The [Tractatus source house](../sources/analytic-philosophy/wittgenstein/wittgenstein-1922-tractatus/wittgenstein-1922-tractatus.md) **sources** the selected work; the [primary text at 4.12–4.1212 and 6.54–7](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/5740/5740-pdf.pdf) supplies the reread context. This is a philosophical account of saying and showing, distinct from a proof of an arithmetical sentence's independence.

<a id="ethics-value-and-the-mystical"></a>
At [6.4–6.522](https://www.gutenberg.org/files/5740/5740-pdf.pdf), this boundary reaches value. Facts describe contingent arrangements; adding another arrangement cannot give them unconditional worth (6.41). Ethics therefore cannot consist of further factual propositions (6.42–6.421). Ethical reward belongs to the act itself rather than an ensuing event (6.422); willing as a psychological phenomenon remains distinguishable from its ethical office (6.423). Good or bad willing changes the world's limits, its character as a whole, rather than adding a fact (6.43). The mystical concerns the world's existence and apprehension as a bounded whole (6.44–6.45). Even a complete scientific account leaves the problem of life untouched; its resolution appears in the problem's disappearance, while the inexpressible shows itself (6.52–6.522). These are positive Tractarian propositions about the relation between factual description and value, not missing entries in a catalogue. The dossier receives an exact limit on what further information accomplishes. Its native determining-act argument and faithful continuation retain their own warrants; silence alone establishes neither.

Its consequence for the dossier is to keep the use of an elucidation within the account of its truth-bearing ambition. A sentence can direct attention to a condition that it fails to state as an additional fact. The reader's passage through it then matters. [A01, Faithful Definition](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **compares** this pressure with Taylor's performed definition, whose positive first-person return belongs to the native argument. The comparison does not transfer that recognition into Wittgenstein's doctrine.

The later [*Philosophical Investigations* house](../sources/analytic-philosophy/wittgenstein/wittgenstein-1953-philosophical-investigations/wittgenstein-1953-philosophical-investigations.md) **historicises** a separate inquiry into use, rule-following and forms of life. The inherited reference-note obligation requires this second work to survive distinctly. A completed later-Wittgenstein treatment needs a selected edition and the actual passages on practices and criteria; the current house carries no verified excerpts. Its admitted question remains consequential here: examine how an expression has a place in an activity, and how a rule's use is established, instead of silently carrying the early book's propositional boundary across the whole later work.

For the essay, this opens a specific investigation of an account's public operation. How does a term acquire a criterion of application? What makes a correction answerable within a practice? These questions concern the use of language through which a claim can be made and challenged. [E3's Logos and Nomos field](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **extends** them in its own register: articulation gives an account a public form, and instituted measure makes that form consequential. Historical Wittgenstein interpretation and E3's authored relational construction retain separate warrants.

## #4 — Precision returns through qualified relation

<a id="cusa-approximation-and-maximum"></a>
Cusa's learned ignorance begins within the desire to know. Book I.1 makes comparative proportion the means of inquiry; I.3 figures the finite intellect's relation to truth through an inscribed polygon and a circle. More angles improve the likeness while the polygon's determinate form remains distinguishable from the circle. Book I.2 and I.4 situate the absolute maximum and coincidence of minimum within the theological inquiry. The [Cusa source house](../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/cusa/cusa-on-learned-ignorance/cusa-on-learned-ignorance.md) **sources** the selected Hopkins edition; the [Latin Book I, chapters 1–4](https://la.wikisource.org/wiki/De_docta_ignorantia/1) corroborates this sequence at text level, without certifying that translation's pagination.

The mathematical image has a precise comparative use. No finite polygon becomes a circle simply by receiving more sides. A modern limiting construction can nevertheless have a circle as its limit: the limit object and each finite member have different offices. Cusa's theological inference therefore needs its own account of truth and maximum. It cannot be supplied by treating a contemporary theorem about convergence as a prohibition of convergence. In the essay's use, increased exactness can disclose the relation of an approximation to what it approaches. That positive gain supports continued inquiry.

The sphere branch retains a different historical task. The infinite-sphere formula associated with the *Liber XXIV Philosophorum*, definition II, needs its own edition and transmission evidence; it is not filed here as Cusa's coinage. His use of mathematical figures, his absolute maximum, and the contracted universe likewise require their distinct textual routes. [C64](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C64-Paradox-Transforming-the-Containing-Field.md) **compares** the consequence as a change in the containing relation under which two determinations are considered, while the Cusan theological setting remains visible.

<a id="eckhart-qualified-predication"></a>
Eckhart enters through the philosophical and theological work of predication. [Flasch's *Meister Eckhart* house](../sources/classical-premodern-philosophy/flasch/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart/flasch-2015-meister-eckhart.md) **sources** the admitted secondary witness, distinguishing the Latin works, Johannine Word, sermons and primary determinations. The inherited apophatic reading proceeds through affirmation, intensification, reversal and release. The predicate first says something; its intensified application exposes the relation in which it can be said; releasing its claim to exhaust the source preserves the work of that relation. Exact external attribution of that sequence still requires the indicated passages, rather than an invented Eckhart quotation.

[C63, Focal Return / Qualified Predication](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C63-Pros-Hen-In-Quantum-Focal-Return-Qualified-Predication.md) **defines** the locally developed *in-quantum* operation. A person considered insofar as just is considered under a determinate respect. That qualification does not certify every act of that person. It lets a predicate remain exact without turning the predicate into possession of its bearer. The focal relation and the qualified respect also remain distinct: several uses can relate to one focus, while each particular assertion still has to say in what respect it holds. Their conjunction is the essay's work.

This gives the Eckhart reference note a substantive return. Predication can become more faithful through an explicit qualification, and apophatic release can preserve what affirmation disclosed. The Word relation has a theological source history of its own; it is not renamed a proof predicate or a native QL coordinate. Flasch's chapter 13, pp.166–176, and chapters 16–17, pp.207–233, identify bounded passage work for that historical development. A01 already owns the native performed definition and its first-person conclusion.

The dossier **returns-to** [E5’s analogical proportion](../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#analogical-proportion) with a different continuation for each limit. Formation can require a changed permission; relative unprovability retains its theory; an elucidation changes how it is used; a qualified predicate states the respect under which it holds. This register-3 comparison preserves the surviving work of each account and keeps its source-specific hypotheses active. It gives the native determining-act argument more exact neighbours without deriving that argument from their common label.

<a id="experience-and-constructive-continuation"></a>
[Frank, Gleiser and Thompson's *The Blind Spot* house](../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/frank/frank-gleiser-thompson-2024-blind-spot/frank-gleiser-thompson-2024-blind-spot.md) **compares** a further pressure: successful abstractions can conceal the experience through which observation and justification become possible. The source's admitted critique concerns the displacement of that dependence by the abstraction. Its exact book passages remain to be registered. The essay's consequence is to keep the means and circumstances of an account operative in its return. [A26, Objective Internality](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **extends** that consequence through notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted worldhood. Changing a permission changes possible action; recording the permission is one part of understanding the world in which it operates. This constitutive argument is native, and it leaves artificial phenomenality Open in both directions.

<a id="optical-figure-and-experiential-verification"></a>
The [inherited Blind Spot note](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/blind-spot-frank-gleiser-thompson.md) **figures** the difference through the optic nerve's location: a local gap in visual reception can itself become an object of anatomical inquiry. Experience as the condition of observing has a different office. Adding an account of the gap still requires an encounter in which that account is read, tested and understood. The figure retains this asymmetry without assigning an unverified passage to the book. In the essay's technical return, model provenance must lead back to the observations, situated judgments and people through whom a result is checked. Human experiential verification includes the ability to contest a model's description of an encounter and make that contest consequential for its next use. An AI system's own confidence report cannot discharge that independent return. This is the essay's argued responsibility for verification; the book's exact AI passages remain a named source task, and artificial phenomenality remains Open.

A limit can also motivate the development of another formalism. The dossier **compares** [Spencer-Brown's *Laws of Form*](../sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form.md), through distinction/re-entry, with [Varela's 1975 calculus](../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q001). Varela's selected printed pp.7–9 now supply the autonomous third state and the dominance, order, constancy and number rules governing reduction; the source's p.7 notation has been visually checked. His [printed pp.21–23](../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q002) develop temporal and systemic interpretations while leaving frequency characterisation as further work. Those admitted passages make the proposed continuation more definite. Intermediate proofs and the complete appendix remain unaudited; the third state does not establish escape from Gödel's conditions for effectively axiomatised arithmetic. The unmarked state and Varela's self-indication retain their own formal offices. Their comparison with native QL still requires the actual mappings, rules and consequences to be displayed.

<a id="frequency-retention-and-signed-dia-research"></a>
The [re-entry note](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/re-entry.md) retains the authorial chain distinction → re-entry → oscillation → frequency → retention as **Argued**. Varela's printed p.21 offers temporal alternation and possible frequency modulation, then expressly leaves frequency characterisation for investigation. It therefore supplies a particular research opening in that chain, not its completed frequency-to-retention derivation. The remaining work here is to specify what recurs, how a frequency is measured, what retains a prior state and how that retention changes the next crossing. The note's signed dia-ballein `(+1)/(−1)` as the `0/1` seam unrolled through generated time remains **Offered, undeveloped authorial research**: it requires an explicit mapping of signs, states and temporal order, with rules preserving the distinction between a re-entering form and its temporal interpretation. The equation `x = not-x` alone supplies none of those specifications. The [developed Laws of Form / Varela comparison](../../matheme/formal-neighbours/laws-of-form-varela.md) **qualifies** the formal boundary; the open development belongs to the native comparison, without downgrading the note's declared argument or assigning it to Varela.

[Whitehead's *Process and Reality*](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q001) **compares** a different positive continuation through newly admitted selected passages in the 1978 corrected edition. Printed pp.21–22 place Creativity, many and one within the Category of the Ultimate: achieved unity enters the diversity available for further becoming, with this sense of one distinguished from the integral number. [Printed pp.23–26](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q002) distinguish prehension's subject, datum and subjective form, and satisfaction as fully determinate integration. [Printed pp.59–60](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q003) coordinate perishing with the achieved occasion's availability to further generation. Completion can therefore be locally real while becoming consequential beyond its own immediacy. This is Whitehead's process-metaphysical continuation, not erasure or proof of an artificial subject. The jointly authored *Principia* has a separate work identity and chronology; no story that Gödel forced Whitehead into process philosophy follows. The [process dossier](process.md) **extends** the source-specific account; exact print quotations and a complete book audit remain separate from these bounded paraphrase admissions.

## #5→0 — Investigation determines; faith continues

<a id="native-definition-and-faith"></a>
[Taylor's Draft 3 house](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) **grounds** the performed theological return in its own identified manuscript. A01 develops the attempt to define God, the definition's encounter with its own predication, its success through acknowledged failure, and the whole relation in which success and failure are held. The first-person recognition changes the register: the one engaged in defining is implicated in what the definition sought. Keeping this movement in A01 preserves its earned conclusion while the dossier makes its external comparisons answerable. None of the distinct source limits above replaces the native traversal.

<a id="file-one-identity-and-provenance"></a>
The [Binary Explication source house](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) **historicises** a distinct, present object: `canonical-candidate/file-one-definitional.md`, titled *File 1 — The Definitional §0/1*, is the definition member of the four-file candidate set. Its work identity differs from the older `file-one/the-self-proving-self.md` stratum and from *The Definition of God — Draft 3*, which the house identifies as a parallel theological application. The sparse [File One Definitional reference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/reference-notes/file-one-definitional.md) preserves an earlier unresolved source pointer. The present candidate is an exact available title/path match; that does not establish which historical object the note originally designated. The alias decision therefore remains **unresolved** pending a dated citation, explicit crosswalk or authorial identification. The old blanket missing-file statement is not repeated as current locality, and the performed definition remains grounded in Draft 3 without substituting that work for File One.

The [complete Investigation and Faith aphorism](../aphorisms/investigation-and-faith.md#complete-aphorism) **defines** the compact relation between approachable limit, absolute limit, determination and faith. Its four lines remain one authored block in their admitted home. [A03](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) gives the determining-act distinction its argument; [A23](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** the different question of a finite life's continuation. Investigation can determine a claim, scrutinise an undertaking and alter an account. Faith consciously carries relation through the non-possession of its ground. An unknown proposition does not become credible merely because another proposition is formally unprovable.

<a id="e3-e4-consumer-return"></a>
The dossier **returns-to** [E3's Fides before arbitration](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#fides-before-arbitration) with the reliance already enacted in inquiry, and **returns-to** [Credere's renewed entrustment](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#credere-renewed-entrustment) with an examined account whose use still requires commitment. The complete movement remains Fides0 → Topos1 → Logos2 → Nomos3 → Natio4 → Credere5 → Fides. This is register-3 relational construction; descent and attested senses retain registers 1 and 2, and poetic re-entry retains register 4. No historical genealogy is inferred from the comparative sequence of this dossier.

It also **returns-to** [E4's Trust operation](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#trust-keeps-the-return-route-active). A source-bound account retains what was established, under which conditions, and what could revise its use. Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The dossier performs those four operations by letting a source's actual limit qualify its philosophical consumption. [The trust-revision house](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust.md) **grounds** the consequent freedom to investigate, correct, withdraw and renew an undertaking. A commitment remains answerable to harm and refusal.

The dossier **returns-to** [M04, the Formal-Limit Genealogy](../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/04-s01-p3-formal-limit-genealogy.md) with differentiated consequences: Russell changes permissible formation; Gödel bounds derivability in a specified system; the early Wittgenstein distinguishes saying and showing, while the later work opens its separate practice inquiry; Cusa and Eckhart retain theological and predicative settings; the experiential and constructive programmes ask what must be recovered or developed for continuation. These are different returns from different limits. The genealogy can carry their relation without pretending they prove one theorem. The next account begins with more exact permissions, warrants and responsibilities than the account with which inquiry arrived.
